German and NATO troops practised a river crossing under combat conditions over the Nemunas River in Lithuania on Friday, moving Leopard tanks and infantry fighting vehicles across on floating platforms as part of the "Freedom Shield 26-II" exercise.
Also on Vantage Shots:
• On November 20, 1985, Microsoft launched Windows 1.0, its very first Windows operating system, marking a major milestone in the history of personal computing. Featuring basic graphics, tiled windows and a mouse-friendly interface, Windows 1.0 introduced a new way for users to interact with their computers.
